Title: Weekly Wednesday Tea on the SU Green
Description: Join us every Wednesday afternoon on the SU Green for our signature weekly tea gathering! 1:00-2:00 PM Quiet Gongfu tea session, 2:00-3:00 PM Social hour.

Title: Gongfu (功夫) Tea Ceremony & Social Hour
Description: Experience the art of Gongfu Cha (功夫茶), the traditional Chinese tea ceremony! 1:00-2:00 PM Quiet tea session, 2:00-3:00 PM Social hour.

Title: Fresh Whisked Matcha Meetup
Description: Join Chinese Tea Club for a relaxing Matcha Meetup! Sip on freshly prepared ceremonial-grade matcha in the 2nd Floor Atrium.

Title: Feng Cha × CTC All-Day Boba Fundraiser
Location: Feng Cha · 2701 Custer Pkwy, Richardson, TX
Description: Support the Chinese Tea Club at UT Dallas by visiting Feng Cha in Richardson! Mention CTC at checkout.

Title: Halloween Tea Meeting: Legend of the White Snake
Description: Wear your Halloween costume to the SU Green for an afternoon of dark roasted oolongs, aged Pu'er, and seasonal treats.

Title: Mid-Autumn Festival Tea & Mooncakes
Description: Celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival with mooncakes paired with fragrant oolong tea on the SU Green.

Title: Mahjong & Tea Social (with Riichi Mahjong & CSA)
Location: Student Union Galaxy Rooms, UT Dallas
Description: Hosted in collaboration with the UTD Riichi Mahjong Club and Chinese Student Association (CSA).

Title: CSA Mid-Autumn Festival Courtyard Fair
Description: Stop by our booth in the ECSW Courtyard for freshly brewed tea alongside egg tarts, performances, and crafts.

Title: The Etymology of Tea: Cha (茶) vs. Te
Description: Dive into the linguistic, Silk Road, and maritime trade history of the character 茶 guided by our Tea Guru.

Title: Three Chinese Fables & Legendary Teas
Description: Storytelling session featuring three classic Chinese tea fables paired with the teas from each legend.

Title: Denton Tea Festival & Vendor Spotlights
Description: Discover local Texas tea vendors, ceramicists, and specialty loose-leaf importers at the Denton Tea Festival.

Title: 2026 Mid-Autumn Asian Arts Festival Showcase
Description: Supported by the UT Dallas Center for Asian Studies celebrating traditional Chinese music and performing arts.
